messages:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: east1-gpu-pool utilization > 98% and queue depth increasing rapidly. autoscaler failing to provision new nodes (error: quota_exceeded). Paging oncall.
mira: I'm on it, pulling up autoscaler logs. jamal, can you confirm whether east1 still has spare capacity in reserved pools?
jamal: checked reserved_pools east1: all reserved nodes are at 100%. We have burst pool but autoscaler API returns 429. suspect cloud quota.
alex: seeing a ton of small short-lived requests causing continuous batching => long queue. routing shows 12k queued requests across east1 primary routes.
sarah: are customers impacted? any 5xx spikes?
mira: yes, SLO alarms: latency p95 crossed 2.5s -> 6s; surfaced errors: 503 backpressure from serving runtime. A handful of high-traffic customers are seeing timeouts.
luis: adding context: cross-region spillover policy should have rerouted to eu1 when east1 saturates, but logs show spillover disabled due to model-variant mismatch for some requests.
jamal: autoscaler logs:
```
2026-03-15T12:03:21Z autoscaler: request provision 8 gpus -> API 429 QuotaExceeded
2026-03-15T12:03:22Z autoscaler: retry backoff, giving up after 3 attempts
2026-03-15T12:03:24Z pool-manager: mark pool hot, refuse evict
```
mira: immediate mitigation options: 1) manual scale up of burst nodes (if quota allows), 2) enable cross-region fallback force-route to eu1 for compatible model variants, 3) temporarily increase token throttling on non-critical routes. Opinions?
alex: force-route to eu1 for chat-generation routes that use x-small variants should help reduce queue fast. But we need to check latency/regulatory tags for affected customers.
jamal: trying manual burst create now. cloud console shows quota remaining 2 GPUs in east1 — not enough. I'll open support ticket but it's slow.
sarah: start customer impact note: affected customers: cust-prod-42, demo-suite, internal-infra-tests. Impact: elevated latency and intermittent 503 for chat/generation endpoints. Severity: P2 (customer-facing, partial outage).
mira: I'll take incident lead. jamal, prioritize forced spillover for compatible model variants; alex, throttle non-paid/test orgs by 50% using rate-limit rule; luis, prepare a list of customers that must not be routed to eu1 (data residency).
luis: copying list to thread now. (private list suppressed). We'll need to keep them pinned to east1 — for those we must present mitigation status to CSMs.
deploy-bot: :information_source: canary rollback not recommended — this is infra capacity, not code.
jamal: applied traffic policy: set route override for model:chat-small -> region eu1, max-fanout 2. Confirming propagation.
ops-bot: :white_check_mark: route-override applied to 83% of edge nodes.
alex: seeing immediate drop in east1 queue by ~28% within 30s. eu1 ingestion rising, p95 there increases from 65ms -> 180ms but still within acceptable.
mira: good. now let's reduce non-critical throughput. alex, please apply the token-based throttles.
alex: throttles live: non-prod orgs 50% reduce, sandbox routes 70%. Monitoring logs for customer errors.
sarah: drafting external status update: "We're investigating increased latency and errors for some generation requests in east1. Traffic has been rerouted to eu1 for compatible models; teams are working on capacity and autoscaler recovery. We will provide updates every 15m." Any objections?
mira: fine. Add note about potential degraded latency for EU-rerouted requests.
jamal: cloud support responded: quota increase delayed ~2 hours. Meanwhile I'll attempt to provision in secondary-subnet with different quota bucket. Initiating now.
luís: (note: public notice to customers with residency constraints prepared)
ops-bot: :warning: autoscaler health check failing: allocation loop error -> insufficient quota and race condition in provisioner. Suspect a changelist yesterday modified backoff threshold.
mira: who's on the autoscaler change? alex?
alex: I rolled the change to adaptively backoff for quota - it reduces retries to avoid API throttles, but apparently when quotas are tight it gives up too early. Reverting patch could let autoscaler attempt more retries but may hit API rate limits.
jamal: quick fix: bump retry attempts from 3 -> 6 in config for autoscaler in east1 only, and add longer spaced backoff to avoid hammering cloud API. I'll push patch to config and roll.
alex: patch applied to east1 config. rolling restarts to controllers.
deploy-bot: :information_source: rollout started for autoscaler-config-east1 v2.3.1-hotfix.
ops-bot: :white_check_mark: autoscaler controller restarted. New config: attempts=6, base_backoff=2s, max_backoff=30s.
jamal: provisioning now shows 6 GPUs requested -> cloud accepted 6 GPUs in secondary-subnet. Pools growing.
alex: east1 queue down to baseline; serving errors returning to normal. Re-enable non-prod throttles stepwise.
sarah: customer impact update: errors reduced; most customers see restored service; cust-prod-42 still reported 5 requests timed out. CSMs notified.
mira: root-cause hypothesis for post-incident timeline: autoscaler config change reduced retry attempts; combined with cloud quota partitioning and a spike of short-lived requests overloaded batching logic causing sustained queueing. That prevented fallback for some variants due to mismatch rules.
luis: follow-ups: 1) revert autoscaler change in main branch and add e2e test for quota-limited provisioning, 2) make spillover policy tolerant to minor model-variant mismatches (fallback to nearest compatible), 3) alert on quota partition exhaustion earlier.
alex: I'll open PR for autoscaler revert + test.
jamal: I'll document the cloud quota partitions and request a permanent quota increase for east1 burst pool.
sarah: I'll draft post-incident customer note and coordinate with CSMs; include timeline and mitigation steps.
mira: good. incident: moving to monitoring phase. Oncall handoff in 30m to alex. If anything spikes above p95 3s reopen.
ops-bot: :white_check_mark: incident acknowledged, severity lowered to P3.
alex: taking over oncall in 30. thanks team.
ops-bot: :memo: Incident timeline appended to ticket INC-354321.
__notes: This thread contains incident coordination for GPU capacity exhaustion in east1, autoscaler failure due to quota and config change, manual routing/force-spillover to eu1, throttling, and hotfix rollout.
